assumptions: The plan is for four people so it safely covers the stated requirement of feeding three or four.
The week starts on the next Monday after the workbook was reviewed: 14 September 2026.
Prices are GBP estimates based on workbook values where supplied and ordinary UK pack prices otherwise; actual shop prices may vary.
Pantry apples are scheduled immediately because the Pantry tab says to use them within two days of 8 September 2026.
The unopened pantry tin of beans had no use-by information, so 8 September 2027 is recorded as a conservative planning date; check the printed date on the tin.
Salt, pepper, cooking oil and common dried herbs/spices are assumed available; fajita seasoning is listed because it is specifically called out in the workbook.
Breakfasts and lunches use the workbook choices, with dinner leftovers deliberately used for lunches to reduce cooking and waste.
Sunday weekly preparation is intended to happen before or alongside the start of the week; prepared items are stored or frozen as noted.

breakfast.notes: Uses the short-dated pantry apples first. Slice only what is needed and refrigerate any cut apple with a little lemon juice.

lunch.meal: Tin of beans on seeded toast
lunch.notes: Uses the pantry tin of beans. One additional tin is bought so four people have a sensible lunch portion.

lunch.notes: Reheat the cooked wedges until piping hot and use four tins of mackerel for four adult-sized servings.

dinner.notes: Uses delicate lettuce and fresh salsa near the start of the week. Cook two extra chicken portions for Wednesday lunch and keep chilled.

breakfast.notes: Uses blueberries while fresh. Extra pancakes can be frozen between sheets of baking paper.

lunch.meal: Chicken mayo sandwiches with leftover fajita chicken

waste_reduction_summary: Use the three short-dated pantry apples first and reduce the bean purchase by the one tin already in stock.
Schedule salmon, broccoli, lettuce, berries and grapes early; rely on frozen fish, chips and peas later in the week.
Reuse Tuesday fajita chicken at Wednesday lunch and Thursday roast chicken at Friday lunch.
Share peppers, lettuce, onions, carrots and potatoes across adjacent meals, using standard pack sizes rather than buying separate quantities.
Make six portions of Saturday soup for Sunday lunch and eight portions of Sunday Bolognese so four can be frozen.
Freeze half the banana bread and cookies, spare bread slices, grated cheese and any chopped celery before quality declines.
The list consolidates duplicate Essentials entries for fish fingers, chips and peas into one purchase each.
